{{Quote|You used to eat better than that.|[[Ngani Zho]] to Theron Shan, after being offered a gelfruit bar|<ref name="Lost Suns 3" />}}
A '''gelfruit bar''' was a processed [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] that could be found during the [[Old Republic era]]. [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Theron Shan]] brought some with [[Gender/Legends|him]] during his [[Mission to the Vesla system|mission]] in the [[Vesla system/Legends|Vesla system]], besides which he also kept reserves of the bars aboard his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Sojourner]]''.<ref name="Lost Suns 3" />
